name: Alive
source:
Nikki, the aspiring photographer. Erin, the wild child. Mary, the girl next door, Stacey, the debutante, and Tonya – the wild card. 

With your best friend Freddie at your side, you’ve always been able to navigate the ups and downs of life with ease. Now as you enter a new phase of your life, will you continue to coast through life, or will the sins of the past come back around? 

[From [url=https://cskinproductions.itch.io/alive]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Nikki，一位有抱负的摄影师。艾琳，野孩子。玛丽是邻家女孩，史黛西是名媛，托尼娅是外卡。

有你最好的朋友弗雷迪在你身边，你总是能够轻松地度过生活的起起落落。现在，当你进入人生的新阶段时，你会继续生活下去，还是过去的罪孽会卷土重来？

[来自[url=https://cskinproductions.itch.io/alive]Itch.io[/url]]
